questions.text:
Lightning is hotter than
the surface of the Sun
questions.say_answer: True! Lightning can be about five times hotter.

questions.text:
You can see the Great Wall
of China from space by eye
questions.fact: It's far too narrow to see
questions.say_answer: False! It's far too narrow to see with the naked eye.

questions.text:
Honey can last for
thousands of years
questions.fact: Edible honey was found in ancient tombs
questions.say_answer: True! Edible honey has been found in ancient Egyptian tombs.

questions.fact: They can remember things for months
questions.say_answer: False! Goldfish can remember things for months.

questions.text:
A day on Venus is longer
than a year on Venus
questions.say_answer: True! One spin takes longer than one trip around the Sun.

yt.title: True or False? 5 Facts That Sound Fake 🤔
yt.description:
Lightning, honey, goldfish and a planet where the day outlasts the year. Five statements: which ones are real? Comment your score 👇
